unrepaired.assessment: The mandatory revision was told the exact excess but expanded the draft and increased the count.

critic.assessment: The critic found a restrained institutional policy-memo paragraph and a whole-draft lack of the corpus's register shifts.

conclusion: The fixed conformance stage is operational and improves deterministic coverage, but a count-only report plus one unconstrained full-prose revision is not reliable enough: it left one measured excess, silently omitted a qualitative dimension, expanded the draft, and did not clear the critic. Stop prompt-only iteration and redesign the conformance interface around located occurrences, explicit edit quotas, minimal patches, and a separate compact rhetorical control plan before another render.
